description: The entire supplied image is a publisher "Check for updates" badge, not a scientific data figure, and it is the only image in this group. It consists of a thick circular ring built from blue and yellow segments, enclosing a solid red bookmark/ribbon shape at its centre; below the ring the words "Check for updates" are printed in dark grey sans-serif type. The badge sits on a light grey gradient background with a thin frame line visible at the top-left corner. There are no axes, units, tick labels, scale bars, legends, sample labels, data points, micrographs, diffraction patterns or spectra anywhere in the image, and no numeric values are printed. No caption was extracted for this figure, and the subject matter of the paper (addition of 3 % Al with and without 1 % Si to an Fe-8Mn-0.2C medium-Mn steel, studied for austenite stability after inter-critical annealing) is not depicted in these pixels. The image therefore carries no scientific information and cannot support any claim about austenite stability, microstructure or mechanical properties.
